name: Baumpilz
desc: A peculiar wooden plank that changes color depending on the environment. One theory is that the fungus contained in the wood used to make these boards is the reason it changes colors.

eff.name: Synthesis: Quality Up
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis increases the synthesized item's quality by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Square
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a square Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
